title: docs deploy is red: llms-full.txt reached 20 MB, Vercel's cap for an ISR page, so every production docs deploy now fails
body:
## What is red

`docs-deploy.yml` failed on its 2026-10-15 01:07 UTC scheduled run (https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/38663939159). Every earlier scheduled run since the workflow landed (#22925) was green. The build passed; the upload of the prebuilt output then failed at Vercel's deploy step:

```
Error: ISR page llms-full.txt is 20.00 MB, over the 20 MB limit, and will fail at runtime (FALLBACK_BODY_TOO_LARGE). Reduce its size and redeploy, or set VERCEL_BYPASS_FALLBACK_OVERSIZED_ERROR=1 to deploy anyway.
```

`apps/docs/app/llms-full.txt/route.ts` concatenates `getLLMText` over every page in `source.getPages()` and declares `revalidate = false`. Vercel stores it as a prerendered ISR fallback, and a fallback body is capped at 20 MB. The docs content has grown past that cap.

## Impact

- Production docs stay on the last successful deploy (2026-10-14 18:51 UTC). Every run, 4 a day, will fail at the same step until this is fixed, so no docs change reaches objectstack.ai in the meantime.
- The failure is loud by design: the workflow goes red instead of skipping. Nothing silently stops publishing.

## Options (pick one)

1. **Serve it as a static asset rather than an ISR page**: write `llms-full.txt` into the build output at build time (for example `public/` or a build-step script), so it is not subject to the 20 MB ISR fallback cap.
2. **Shrink it**: drop sections an LLM reader does not need, or split it into per-section files linked from `llms.txt`.
3. **Bypass** with `VERCEL_BYPASS_FALLBACK_OVERSIZED_ERROR=1`. Not recommended: Vercel says the page "will fail at runtime".

Option 1 or 2 is the real fix. Content keeps growing, so a fix that only gets the file just under 20 MB will break again.
